hooks.command: bash -c 'd=$PWD; while [ "$d" != / ] && [ "$d" != . ] && [ ! -f "$d/scripts/session-start-stamp" ]; do d=$(dirname "$d"); done; [ -f "$d/scripts/session-start-stamp" ] && exec bash "$d/scripts/session-start-stamp"; echo "codex SessionStart: could not resolve scripts/session-start-stamp from $PWD" >&2'
